codes.name: COMPLETE
codes.description: A request to add a completed appointment, used to maintain records of completed appointments that did not appear in the schedule (e.g., STAT, walk-in, etc.)

codes.name: NORMAL
codes.description: Routine schedule request type - default if not valued

codes.name: TENTATIVE
codes.description: A request for a tentative (e.g., “penciled in”) appointment
